sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in unison submit that the parties to the lis have settled their dispute among themselves.
The parties to the lis were before the family Court in M.C.No.1746/2015 and the concerned Court by its judgment passed a decree of divorce.
The complainant filed a revision petition before this Court in Crl.R.P.No.11/2022 and the parties settled their dispute among themselves during the pendency of the revision petition.
The parties have parted their ways and filed a joint memo in the revision petition, by drawing up certain terms and conditions and a copy of which is appended to the petition.
One of the NC: 2024:KHC:27363 conditions of the settlement also recognizes the closure of the present proceedings.

3. The joint memo reads as follows:
"xxxxx a.
The Petitioner undertakes that the cases referred to in the Schedule 'A' to this Joint Memo shall be unconditionally withdrawn by her before closure of the captioned petition.

b. The Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the 1st Respondent and his family with quashing of the proceedings in C.C. No.27052 of 2015pending on the file of the 7th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru.
c. The 1st Respondent undertakes that the cases referred to in the Schedule 'B' to this Joint Memo shall be unconditionally withdrawn by him before closure of the captioned petition.

d. The original suit filed by the 2nd Respondent (i.e., the mother of the 1st Respondent, to whom the issuance of notice has been dispensed with)in Original Suit No.25123 of 2017 pending on the file of the Addl.
City Civil
and Sessions Judge (CCH-29), Mayo Hall, Bengaluru shall be withdrawn before closure of the captioned petition.
The Petitioner declares that she has no manner of right, title or interest in the Suit Schedule Property.
She further undertakes not to interfere with the 1st Respondent / his parents' peaceful possession of the said property.

e. That in the event either party does not withdraw the cases referred to in Schedule 'A' and Schedule 'B' as stated supra and any other case/s (other than those mentioned in Schedule 'A' and 'B') pending NC: 2024:KHC:27363 against each other or their family members as on date, it shall be lawful for other party to get such of the case/s which are not withdrawn to be dismissed on the strength of this joint memo and orders passed by this Hon'ble Court.

In relation to any other matter pending between them, the terms of the present settlement and the orders passed by this Hon'ble Court shall be brought to the notice of the concerned Courts and other authorities.

f. The Petitioner and the 1st Respondent undertake that they shall not file any cases against each other or their family members or institute any proceedings whatsoever,
in future.

However, any non-compliance of any of the terms of this Joint Memo would render the defaulting party liable and entitle the other party to initiate K Prasad vs State Of Karnataka on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163179934/

FD receipt will be shared with the 1st Respondent within 2 weeks of the closure.

subject to realisation.

12 The 1st Respondent undertakes to pay the Petitioner, balance of Rs.55,00,000/-
[Rupees Fifty-Five Lakhs only]upon withdrawal / closure of all pending cases as stated above and at rate within a period of 4 weeks from the date of execution of this Joint Memo before this Hon'ble Court i.e., at the time closure of the captioned petition.

Any such documents, papers which are retained by either party shall be null and void without having any consequences in the eyes of Law.
